dropForge.settings.title: Launch Automation
dropForge.settings.preparationOff: EMMA preparation is Off. Enable it in Drop Forge Launch Automation to start or resume processing.
dropForge.settings.launchReadOnly: You can change EMMA preparation. The contract owner and claims administrators can change launch and payment settings.
dropForge.settings.loadError: Launch automation is not configured or could not be loaded.
dropForge.settings.saveError: Could not save launch settings. Refresh and try again.
dropForge.funding.invalid: Enter a positive ETH amount with no more than 18 decimal places.
dropForge.funding.insufficient: Your wallet needs enough ETH for the top-up and network fee.
dropForge.funding.changed: The wallet, network or funding details changed. Review the top-up again.
dropForge.funding.failed: The top-up could not be completed. Check its transaction before trying another transfer.
dropForge.funding.cancelled: The top-up was cancelled in your wallet.
dropForge.funding.reportPending: The transaction hash is retained for reporting. You can refresh without sending another transfer.
dropForge.funding.storageError: Transaction evidence could not be saved. Copy the transaction hash before closing this page.
dropForge.funding.replaced: The top-up was replaced with different transaction details in your wallet. Inspect the transaction before sending another transfer.
dropForge.settings.helpLaunch: On makes Launch available in Craft. Click it to start automation for that card. Off pauses new automated actions. Manual Launch remains available.
dropForge.settings.helpPreparation: On shows Process and Finalize in EMMA. Click it to run preparation and finalization in the background. Off restores the original EMMA flow and pauses jobs after their current step. Turn it back on to resume. This works independently of Automatic launch.
dropForge.settings.helpPayment: Save & Enable stores your ETH limit and enables payments. Disable keeps the limit so you can use it again with Enable.
dropForge.settings.helpTiming: Research and enabled artist payments become eligible at 18:00 Athens time the day after minting opens.
dropForge.settings.helpOps: Readiness checks run even with automation off. Skips are reported in Drop Forge Ops. Submitted transactions are tracked through confirmation.
